result.title: Export ready
result.started: Your download should start automatically. If it didn’t, use Download again.
result.full.options-changed: A full export was made because the format options differ from the previous export. Files that are no longer produced are listed in export-deleted.txt.
result.full.other-source: A full export was made because the previous export comes from another site, space or page.

result.missing.one: {count} page from the previous export was not found — it was deleted or you can’t see it. Its files are listed in export-deleted.txt.
result.missing.other: {count} pages from the previous export were not found — they were deleted or you can’t see them. Their files are listed in export-deleted.txt.

result.apply.title: Apply this update
result.apply.step1: Put the zip next to the docs folder that holds your previous export.
result.apply.step2: Run this command: it overwrites changed files and removes the files listed in export-deleted.txt.
result.apply.step3: Review the changes with git status and commit them.
